acceptanceCriteria: Every scoped reference artifact is classified as equivalent, different-by-design, or a concrete bounded gap with a counterpart or no-counterpart reason.
Capability and status projections are deterministic JSON, explicit --repo bound, and include repositoryId plus current snapshot/digest bindings.
Observed facts are not presented as verified implementation; missing or malformed profile/evidence fails closed and unknowns remain visible.
No Work Item or source repository state is shared across two repositories; parallel isolation regression covers concurrent A/B repositories.
Three-language capability and command documentation describes the projection boundary without claiming the reference Python/Make runtime was copied.

The six scoped deferred inventory records name exact Rust counterparts or explicit no-counterpart reasons, none remains deferred-next-batch, and the inventory regression rejects an empty classification result.
The scoped tests and current repository quality gates pass, and a visible human Outcome is produced.
goal: Provide a truthful Rust-native adopter capability/status projection with explicit repository identity and snapshot bindings.
intent: Compare and, where necessary, implement the reference adopter capability manifest and machine-readable Work Item status boundary without copying the reference Python or Make runtime; expose only repository-bound, evidence-derived facts.

scenarioCoverage.expected: Concurrent capability and Work Item status projections for repositories A and B remain identity- and snapshot-bound without cross-repository state.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run repository isolation tests with concurrent A/B projections and verify repositoryId, snapshot digest, and output paths.

scenarioCoverage.expected: observe, capability, and status projections leave repository bytes unchanged.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Capture byte and metadata manifests before and after repeated projection commands, including symlinks and directories.

scenarioCoverage.expected: Missing, malformed, stale, or foreign capability/status inputs remain non-green and expose stable unknowns.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run tamper and identity regression fixtures against capability and all-Work-Item status projections.
